title: ononis natrix subsp. microphylla
intro: Ononis natrix subsp. microphylla, commonly known as Small-leaved Jointed Crowfoot, is a plant species within the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit analgesic and antispasmodic properties, and potentially protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Ononis natrix subsp. microphylla include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic potential.
